title: Ogre Butcher
html:
It lives on Ogre Isle, which you can only reach after finishing The Ogre Traitor (Gerald Seabroden).

A level 40 Ogre that attacks with crush (melee).

Fighting it

Weak burnfreezeshockcrush   Resists stab

A weakness adds 30% damage and a resistance takes 30% off (the game's own rule).

⭐ Seen as an elite 101 times (6.4% of sightings). Elites have 3× HP, hit 1.4× harder, give 3× XP and 2.5× loot.

Reagent: Giants Knucklebone (infuses an enchant), Ogre Bone Needle (crafting catalyst). About 1 kill in 500, 1 in 50 from an elite. Enchanter’s Table
